title: Package Allowance Credit Memos for Removed Option Lines — Design Studio Selections
content:
When an option line carrying package allowance is removed from a Design Studio Selections file, the allowance applied to it is returned to the file under its own credit memo carrying the removed line's number; the return restores allowance already granted and is not a second grant of the package allowance. The credit memo raises the design credit available on the file by the amount returned, and the buyer sees it on the design file.

## Ledger tool: `return_line_allowance_4e51d426`

**Capability.** One call adds one package allowance credit entry to the file's design ledger, dated today, carrying the line number of the removed line and a new printed credit memo number, and raises the file's design credit available by the amount returned.

**Invocation.** It is an agent-side tool: the representative unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `selection_id` | The reference number of the Design Studio Selections file that receives the returned allowance, as returned by the design file lookup | Id |
| `source_line_ref` | The line number of the removed option line the allowance had been applied to, exactly as printed on its removal entry in the design ledger | Verbatim, copied character for character |
| `credit_amount` | The package allowance returned to the file | USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** A receipt with `design_event_id` (the reference number of the credit entry), `credit_reference` (the printed credit memo number, DCM- followed by five digits), `source_line_ref` (as passed), `credit_amount` (the allowance returned, USD with 2 decimals), `design_credit_balance` (the file's design credit available in USD including this return) and `status`, which reads "returned" when the credit was written.
